mapper.select:
select v.id, v.folder, v.rel_path, v.title, v.size, v.dur, v.w, v.h, v.vcodec, v.browser_ok, v.poster_path, v.doc_path, v.sub_path, v.hidden, v.mtime, v.rating, v.missing, v.last_seen from media_video v
and v.hidden = #{hidden}
and (v.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.rel_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and v.folder = #{folder}
and v.vcodec like concat('%', #{vcodec}, '%')
and exists (select 1 from media_video_actor a where a.video_id = v.id and a.name = #{person})
and exists (select 1 from media_video_tag vt where vt.video_id = v.id and vt.tag_id in #{tid})
order by
v.size desc, v.dur desc, v.mtime desc, v.title asc, v.folder asc, v.title asc,
v.id asc

select a.id, a.person_id, a.title, a.dir, a.photo_count, a.bytes, a.cover_path, a.note, a.sort, a.hidden, a.mtime from media_album a
and a.hidden = #{hidden}
and (a.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.dir like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and a.person_id = #{personId}
order by
a.photo_count desc, a.bytes desc, a.title asc, a.sort asc,
a.id asc
select p.id, p.album_id, p.seq, p.rel_path, p.bytes, p.w, p.h, p.is_big, p.hidden, p.missing, p.last_seen, p.content_hash from media_photo p where p.album_id = #{albumId} order by p.seq asc
select id, root_id, folder, rel_path, title, size, dur, w, h, vcodec, browser_ok, poster_path, doc_path, sub_path, hidden, mtime, rating, missing, last_seen from media_video where id = #{id}
select id, root_id, album_id, seq, rel_path, bytes, w, h, is_big, hidden, missing, last_seen, content_hash from media_photo where id = #{id}
select id, root_id, album_id, seq, rel_path, bytes, w, h, is_big, hidden, missing, last_seen, content_hash from media_photo where album_id = #{albumId} and seq = #{seq}
select p.root_id from media_photo p where p.album_id = #{albumId} and p.root_id is not null order by p.seq asc limit 1
mapper.update: update media_video set hidden = #{hidden} where id = #{id}
update media_album set hidden = #{hidden} where id = #{id}
update media_photo set hidden = #{hidden} where id = #{id}
update media_album set person_id = #{personId} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from media_video where hidden = 0) as videos, (select count(*) from media_album where hidden = 0) as albums, (select count(*) from media_photo p inner join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id and a.hidden = 0 where p.hidden = 0) as photos, (select count(*) from media_person where hidden = 0) as people, (select count(*) from media_video where hidden = 1) as hiddenVideos, (select count(*) from media_album where hidden = 1) as hiddenAlbums, (select count(*) from media_photo where hidden = 1) as hiddenPhotos, (select count(*) from media_photo where missing = 1) as missingPhotos, (select count(*) from media_video where missing = 1) as missingVideos, (select coalesce(sum(size), 0) from media_video where hidden = 0) as videoBytes, (select coalesce(sum(bytes), 0) from media_album where hidden = 0) as albumBytes
select folder as `name`, count(*) as `count`, coalesce(sum(size), 0) as `bytes` from media_video where hidden = 0 group by folder order by 2 desc, 1 asc

select p.id as `id`, p.name as `name`, count(case when a.hidden = 0 then 1 end) as `albums`, coalesce(sum(case when a.hidden = 0 then a.photo_count else 0 end), 0) as `photos` from media_person p left join media_album a on a.person_id = p.id where p.hidden = 0 group by p.id, p.name, p.sort order by p.sort asc, p.id asc
select rel_path from media_video where hidden = 0 order by id asc limit #{limit}

select p.id, p.root_id, p.album_id, p.seq, p.rel_path, p.bytes, p.w, p.h, p.is_big, p.hidden, p.missing, p.last_seen, p.content_hash from media_photo p where p.album_id = #{albumId} order by p.missing asc, p.seq asc

select v.id, v.root_id, v.folder, v.rel_path, v.title, v.size, v.dur, v.w, v.h, v.vcodec, v.browser_ok, v.poster_path, v.doc_path, v.sub_path, v.hidden, v.mtime, v.rating, v.missing, v.last_seen from media_video v where v.missing = 1 order by v.last_seen asc, v.rel_path asc, v.id asc
mapper.delete: delete from media_video_tag where video_id in #{it}
delete from media_video_actor where video_id in #{it}
delete from media_video_marker where video_id in #{it}
mapper.select: select id from media_video where missing = 1 order by id
